meaning.zh:
“要付出惨痛代价” 或 “要受到严厉的惩罚”。

这个短语来源于 “地狱” 的概念，象征着极其严重的后果或巨大的困苦。这个 idiom 通常用于描述某人如果做错事或者没有遵守规则，将会面临非常严重的后果。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the concept of "hell," which represents extreme consequences or great suffering. It is typically used to indicate that someone will face severe repercussions if they do something wrong or fail to follow the rules.

lines.en: If he finds out you broke his favorite vase, you'll *have hell to pay*.
lines.zh: 如果他发现你打破了他最喜欢的花瓶，你会付出惨痛代价。

lines.en: You *will have hell to pay* if you don't finish this project on time.
lines.zh: 如果你没有按时完成这个项目，你会受到严厉的惩罚。

lines.en: There will be *hell to pay* if they catch you cheating on the exam.
lines.zh: 如果他们抓到你考试作弊，你会有大麻烦。
